question: A collection of programs that controls how the computer system runs and processes information is called
solution:
The correct answer is __**Operating System**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Operating System**

 
 
• **It collection of programs that controls how the computer system runs and processes information**__.
 
• It consists of programs, which controls, coordinate and supervise the activities of the various components of a computer system.
 
• Its function is to provide a link between the computer hardware and the user.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• A **compiler** is a software tool that converts the source code written in a high-level programming language like C++, Java, or Python into machine code or executable code that can be run on a computer.
 
• An **assembler **is a software tool that converts assembly language code into machine code. 
 
 
• Assembly language is a low-level programming language that is closer to machine language than high-level languages. 
 
• An assembler translates assembly code instructions into machine code instructions that can be executed by a computer.
 
 
 
• A **linker **is a software tool that combines object files and libraries to create an executable file or a shared library. 
 
 
• When a program is compiled, it is usually split into multiple object files, each containing a portion of the program's code. 
 
• The linker takes these object files and combines them to create an executable file or a shared library that can be run on a computer.
